title: Public pet and ticket save shows a success flash
summary: Public create and save of a Shelter pet, and public ticket create or comment, now show a short success message. The wording stays everyday language.
changes: Show a success flash after a public Shelter pet is created or saved.
Show a success flash after a public ticket is created or a comment is added.
affected_areas: Public Shelter pet create and save
version_rationale: Patch release: adds a missing success flash on public pet and ticket save without changing permissions or ticket lifecycle.
validation: PHPUnit PublicShelterPetSaveFlashTest covers public Shelter pet create and save flashes and persisted pet data.
PHPUnit PublicTicketSaveFlashTest covers public ticket create and comment flashes on APES CIC, Shelter, and Pet Care.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: The Pet Care clinic pet create path is unchanged and still has no create flash.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore silent redirects after public pet create and ticket create.
provenance: Public pet and ticket save success flash for issue #153, pull request #203.
